name: Nirvana Task API
description: Nirvana Task API (Public Beta). Clean REST endpoints for integrations, automation, and AI agents (MCP servers, scripts, webhooks). Auth: `Bearer <nirvana-auth-token>`. Legacy v0 endpoints are removed from this service; migrate integrations to /v1/* endpoints. During beta, backward compatibility is best-effort and minor response changes may occur before GA.
